acts.desc: Ira talks about the classic biography of an American pimp, Iceberg Slim's Pimp: The Story of My Life, and explains today's show. He warns listeners that although there's no sex in the show at all, there is a scene or two in which men hit women.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: How Kevin and his friends got into the game of pimping, and the rules of the game at the time.
acts.title: Rules Of The Game

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Kevin's story continues. We hear about his own rise and fall as a pimp, and how he failed in his attempt to be a different kind of pimp—a less cruel kind.
acts.title: The Price Of Ignoring The Rules
